body:
## Problem

`DockerRuntime.List()` in `pkg/runtime/docker.go:155` uses `docker ps -a --no-trunc --format '{{json .}}'` to list containers. The `{{json .}}` template dumps **all** fields including `Size`, which causes Docker CLI to send `size=1` to the daemon API (`/containers/json?all=1&size=1`).

This triggers `snapshotter.Usage()` on every container's overlay filesystem. If any file in a container's overlay diff is deleted between the `readdir()` and `lstat()` calls during the directory walk (a classic TOCTOU race), the entire `docker ps` call fails with:

```
snapshotter.Usage failed for <sha>: lstat /var/lib/containerd/io.containerd.snapshotter.v1.overlayfs/snapshots/<id>/fs/tmp/tmp.XYZ: no such file or directory
```

This is a **deterministic failure** on hosts where containers have high `/tmp` churn (e.g., agent containers running Go builds, tests, etc.). One container on scion-community has 25,313 files in its overlay `/tmp` directory, making the TOCTOU race essentially guaranteed — `docker ps` fails 10/10 times with `{{json .}}`, and succeeds 10/10 times with explicit fields that exclude `Size`.

## Root Cause

The `dockerListOutput` struct only uses 5 fields:
```go
type dockerListOutput struct {
    ID     string `json:"ID"`
    Names  string `json:"Names"`
    Status string `json:"Status"`
    Image  string `json:"Image"`
    Labels string `json:"Labels"`
}
```

But `{{json .}}` returns 15 fields including `Size`, `Command`, `CreatedAt`, `LocalVolumes`, `Mounts`, `Networks`, `Platform`, `Ports`, `RunningFor`, `State`. The `Size` field is the only one that triggers the expensive and failure-prone `snapshotter.Usage()` call.

## Impact

When `docker ps` fails, the broker's `listAgents()` endpoint returns an error, which causes:
- Agent list/status queries to fail
- Message delivery to fail (broker can't find target agent's container)
- Web terminal/PTY attach to fail
- Silent message loss (hub marks message as "dispatched" but broker never delivers — see #1866)

On scion-community, this caused 21+ failures in 45 minutes after a Docker restart, with ongoing failures every few seconds.

## Fix

Change line 155 from:
```go
args := []string{"ps", "-a", "--no-trunc", "--format", "{{json .}}"}
```

To use a format string that produces JSON with only the needed fields:
```go
args := []string{"ps", "-a", "--no-trunc", "--format",
    `{"ID":{{json .ID}},"Names":{{json .Names}},"Status":{{json .Status}},"Image":{{json .Image}},"Labels":{{json .Labels}}}`}
```

This produces identical JSON output but avoids triggering size calculation, since the format template no longer references the `Size` field. Docker CLI only adds `size=1` when it detects the template uses `.Size`.

## Verification

Tested on scion-community (Docker 29.4.0, 76 containers, corrupt overlay snapshots):

| Format | Result |
|--------|--------|
| `{{json .}}` | **Fails 10/10** (exit code 1) |
| `{{.ID}} {{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}} {{.Labels}}` | **Succeeds 10/10** (exit code 0) |

## Related

- #1864 — broker resilience to docker ps failures (retry/fallback)
- #1866 — silent message loss when broker fails
title: fix: docker ps format triggers unnecessary size calculation, causing failures
